data.one_liner: Kotlin-inspired convenience methods and helper extensions for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Supercharged Dart brings comfort features and extensions from languages like Kotlin to all Dart developers. It provides utility methods for core types like Iterables and Durations.
use_when: You want Kotlin-style convenience methods for Dart core types
You are looking for helper utilities for Iterables and Durations
avoid_when: You want a package that is actively maintained and not discontinued
You want to avoid potential naming conflicts with native Dart methods
strengths: Provides familiar utility methods from Kotlin
Enhances core Dart types with extra functionality
weaknesses: Many methods had to be renamed to avoid conflicts with Dart's own implementations
